d: In this video, you will learn how devolvement works in commodity options and how it can impact your trading account margin requirements after expiry. When a commodity option expires in the money, it does not simply settle in cash but is instead converted into a corresponding futures position which requires significantly more capital. Understanding this mechanism is crucial for managing your positions because the exchange blocks progressive margins leading up to the expiry day, and Zerodha may square off your trade if sufficient funds are not maintained.
